translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ruoth oil nikech teko ma imiye.
Mano kaka en gi mor maduongʼ nikech isemiyo olocho!
Isemiye gima chunye gombo
kendo pok idagi timone kwayone. Sela
Ne irwake gi gweth momew
kendo nisidho osimbo mar dhahabu maler e wiye.
Ne okwayi ngima kendo ne imiye;
ne imede ndalo mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.
Kuom loch mane ichiwo, duongʼ mare duongʼ;
isemiye huma gi luor.
Adier, isemiye gweth mochwere
kendo isemiyo obedo mamor gi mor moa kuomi.
Nikech ruoth ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
kuom hera ma ok rum mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
ok obi yiengni.
Lweti biro mako wasiki duto;
lweti ma korachwich biro ndhiyo joma kedo kodi.
E sa ma ibiro chopoe,
to ibiro miyo gichal gi kendo mar mach mager.
Jehova Nyasaye biro mwonyogi kuom mirimbe mager,
kendo mach mare biro tiekogi.
Ibiro tieko kothgi mi rum e piny,
kendo nyithindgi biro rumo e dier ji.
Kata obedo ni gichano timoni marach
kendo giloso chenro maricho, to ok ginyal loyo;
nikech ibiro miyo gilok dier ngʼegi
ka ibiro dimbogi gi atungʼ moywa.
Yud duongʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kuom tekoni maduongʼ;
wabiro wer kendo pako nyalo mari.
